node.title: Re^3: Having to manually escape quote character in args to "system"?
node.author: haukex
node.doctext: Thank you very much for the details! I hardly ever run external commands on Windows, so I haven't gotten into the details very much, other than that Win32 apparently doesn't have an equivalent of [man://execvp;3|execvp(3)], and that Perl actually does [https://perl5.git.perl.org/perl.git/blob/d6150e10:/win32/win32.c#l3421|its own quoting internally], which unfortunately doesn't seem to be perfect. But I have heard a few good things about [mod://Win32::ShellQuote], and I haven't had any problems with [mod://IPC::Run3] on Windows (although I may just have not yet run into a case of really complicated quoting).
